## Line 453

```plato

    // The centroid (center of mass under uniform density) of the region enclosed by
    // a closed ring: Cx = 1/(6A) * sum (x_i + x_i+1) * cross_i, and likewise for Cy,
    // where cross_i is the shoelace term and A the signed area.
    // Precondition: non-zero signed area (a degenerate ring has no centroid).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centroid#Of_a_polygon
    PolygonAreaCentroid(points: Array<Point2D>): Point2D
    {
        var n = points.Count;
        var cross = n.MapRange(i =>
            points[i].X * points.AtModulo(i + 1).Y
            - points.AtModulo(i + 1).X * points[i].Y);
        var twiceArea = SumOf(cross);
        var cx = SumOf(n.MapRange(i => (points[i].X + points.AtModulo(i + 1).X) * cross[i]));
        var cy = SumOf(n.MapRange(i => (points[i].Y + points.AtModulo(i + 1).Y) * cross[i]));
        return (cx / (3.0 * twiceArea), cy / (3.0 * twiceArea));
    }
```
